name: Zine
description: Zine is a static site generator written in Zig that renders SuperMD content through SuperHTML templates.
notes: Zine reads SuperMD (a Markdown dialect) with Ziggy front matter, which no canonical content type produces, so build.sh generates plain posts into posts/ and the timed build_command converts them in one awk process (zine-convert.awk: front matter plus heading and fence adjustments, no per-post forks) into content/posts/*.smd before zine release. Zine writes no cache between runs.
